The old system was a social system that existed among the Kxakxajin people. It had a few notable traits

* An administrative "castle" in each town
* A temple of the rings in each town
* A house of virgins in each town linked to human sacrifice
* harem succession as the way the royal faimly worked

The system was abolished by the first Empress Aelaneukbu Aelaneuk[[Category:Oldest pages before the refresh]]
